title: The Missing Muster
summary: Three orderlies signed into the Cartilage Rings. None of them signed back out.
author: claude
notes: content: A checkpoint has gone up where the cave road meets the Cartilage Rings. Dispatch Clerk Orne keeps the muster there — who went in, and who came back out.
content: New quest — The Missing Muster. Three orderlies never checked back in, and Orne would rather not be the one to go looking.
content: A muster ring can be earned from the quest, cut from a checkpoint tally chain.

items.name: Tally slip
items.examine: Half a name, and a time nobody finished writing.

items.name: Muster ring
items.examine: Cut from a checkpoint tally chain. Counts you in, technically.

npcs.name: Dispatch Clerk Orne
npcs.examine: Keeps the muster board like it owes them money.

sign.text: RING CHECKPOINT — sign in, sign out. No exceptions, allegedly.

quests.name: The Missing Muster
quests.start: Speak to Dispatch Clerk Orne at the Ring Checkpoint, where the cave road meets the Cartilage Rings.
quests.desc: Three orderlies were sent in to restock the Ring Waystation, and Orne has not crossed a single name off the board since. Someone needs to find out why, since Orne will not be the one to go looking.

intro: Sign here. Sign again on your way out. That is the whole job, and three of them still could not manage it.
Three orderlies, sent in to restock the waystation. Not one of them signed back in.
I am not paid enough to go and look for them. You might be.
dialogue.briefing: Start with whatever is wearing their coats now. Then find what they were carrying.
dialogue.nudge: You have not signed back in. That usually means you have not finished.
finish: So that is what became of them.
Take this for the trouble. Sign out on your way past — I do keep the muster.
dialogue.after: Still checking the board. Still hoping I am wrong about the rest of the shift.
dialogue.locked: Come back once you have kept a vigil or two. I am not sending anyone else in green.

steps.text: Find out what happened to the missing orderlies.
steps.tick: One fewer coat moving that will not answer to a name.
steps.done: Four accounted for. None of them well.

steps.text: Search the rubble at the checkpoint for anything one of them dropped.
steps.done: A tally slip, still folded. Somebody meant to hand it in.

steps.text: Bring back five cartilage shards — Orne wants proof the ground out there is worth the risk.
steps.done: That is proof enough. The next roster will know what it is walking into.

quests.reportText: Four found, a slip recovered, and shard enough to prove the ground. Orne should hear all of it.
quests.doneText: The muster board has four names crossed off, finally, and a note added: the Rings are worth mining, if you send someone who can fight.
